slides.title:
Where water
meets fire
slides.subtitle: The doorway the classics call Gandanta

slides.label: Rule 10
slides.title: Three doorways
body: Three times round the zodiac a water sign ends and a fire sign begins.
slides.closing: Cancer to Leo, Scorpio to Sagittarius, Pisces to Aries

slides.label: The knot
slides.title: Gandanta
body: The last degrees of a water sign and the first of a fire sign. A graha here stands between two worlds.
slides.closing: What is ending and what is starting get tangled

slides.label: How to read it
slides.title: Is it in a doorway?
items: Is the graha in a water or a fire sign?
Is it near the end of water or the start of fire?
Then it stands in a doorway

slides.label: Monday 23 November
slides.title:
Two in Leo’s
doorway

items.head: The monk (Ketu)
items.line: Just over half a degree into Leo, walking backward toward Cancer.

items.head: The teacher (Jupiter)
items.line: About 2 degrees into Leo, and slowing down.

slides.note: The soldier (Mars) walked out on Thursday 19 November

slides.label: Coming up
slides.title:
Both stay
at the door
body: On Saturday 5 December, about noon, the monk walks back through it into Cancer.
On 12 December the teacher stops there and turns backward.

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Finish the old first
body: Like closing one tab before you open the next.
